#Blueface Was Furious After Coming Home To Find His Range Rover Missing 👀 He’s Now Placing An Alert On it And Says His BM Could End Up In Jail If She Took It 😳 

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper and internet personality who became one of the most recognizable names from the late-2010s West Coast rap scene. Before music, Blueface played quarterback at Arleta High School in Los Angeles and later briefly played college football at Fayetteville State University before eventually focusing on music.

Blueface started gaining attention with songs like “Dlocs”* and “Respect My Cryppin’,” with the latter going viral in 2018 because of his unique off-beat flow, voice, and delivery. His career reached another level with “Thotiana,” which became his biggest mainstream hit and reached the Top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100. The song also received major remixes featuring YG and Cardi B.

He released his breakout project Famous Cryp and later signed with Cash Money West. Blueface continued releasing music and eventually dropped his debut studio album Find the Beat, featuring artists such as Gunna, NLE Choppa, DaBaby, and others. His unusual flow, West Coast sound, humor, and personality helped separate him from other rappers coming up during the same era.

Outside of music, Blueface became a major social-media personality through livestreaming, reality-style content, boxing, viral moments, and his highly publicized personal life. Over the years, his relationships and legal situations have also received significant attention online. Despite the controversy surrounding his career, Blueface has remained a recognizable figure in West Coast rap and internet culture, with “Thotiana” continuing to be the record most associated with his rise to mainstream fame.
